import hashlib,json,subprocess,threading
from pathlib import Path
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler,ThreadingHTTPServer
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]; OUT=ROOT/"target/asymmetric-range-cap-verification"; OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
DATA=hashlib.shake_256(b"IDG asymmetric range size cap").digest(8*1024*1024); EXPECTED=hashlib.sha256(DATA).hexdigest(); rows=[]
for name,binary,success in [("bounded-queue","perf-idg-bounded-handoff.exe",True),("single-wave","perf-idg-single-wave-prototype.exe",False)]:
 seen=[]
 class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
  protocol_version="HTTP/1.1"
  def log_message(self,*args): pass
  def do_GET(self):
   start,end=map(int,self.headers["Range"].removeprefix("bytes=").split("-"));end=min(end,len(DATA)-1)
   allowed=(start==0 and end==2*1024*1024-1) or end-start+1<=512*1024
   seen.append({"start":start,"end":end,"status":206 if allowed else 413})
   self.send_response(206 if allowed else 413);self.send_header("Connection","close");self.send_header("Content-Length",str(end-start+1 if allowed else 0))
   if allowed:self.send_header("Content-Range",f"bytes {start}-{end}/{len(DATA)}");self.send_header("ETag",'"fixed"');self.send_header("Content-Type","application/octet-stream")
   self.end_headers()
   if allowed:
    try:self.wfile.write(DATA[start:end+1])
    except (BrokenPipeError,ConnectionResetError,ConnectionAbortedError):pass
 server=ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",0),Handler);server.daemon_threads=True;thread=threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start();dest=OUT/(name+".bin");exe=ROOT/"target"/binary
 try:r=subprocess.run([str(exe),f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}/file.bin",str(dest),"0"],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf-8",errors="replace",timeout=20)
 finally:server.shutdown();server.server_close();thread.join()
 actual=hashlib.sha256(dest.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if dest.exists() else None
 row={"case":name,"binary_sha256":hashlib.sha256(exe.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"exit_code":r.returncode,"expected_success":success,"actual_sha256":actual,"expected_sha256":EXPECTED,"requests":seen,"stdout":r.stdout,"stderr":r.stderr}
 assert (r.returncode==0)==success,row
 if success:assert actual==EXPECTED and dest.stat().st_size==len(DATA),row
 else:assert "413" in r.stderr,row
 row["verified"]=True;rows.append(row)
(OUT/"results.json").write_text(json.dumps({"fixture_source":Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8"),"results":rows},indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps([{k:r[k] for k in ["case","exit_code","expected_success","verified"]} for r in rows],indent=2))
